source_context.source_summary: Canonical registry, portfolio operating graph, data preservation, QA, autonomous sweep, LLM/browser extraction, commercial, research, runtime and governance layers.

objective: Build the Portfolio Operating Graph without data loss: preserve existing registry content, convert it into canonical schema/code, enqueue bridge execution, produce receipt, then route to dev for test/validation and prod promotion gating.
non_negotiables: No prod promotion without validation receipt
Every entity requires canonical_slug, owner, lifecycle, environment, evidence_level
All writes must emit receipt/audit event

build_plan.name: Canonical spine
build_plan.done_when: Existing and new entities can be inserted idempotently without overwriting source data.

build_plan.name: Governance enforcement
build_plan.done_when: Invalid transitions and prod without evidence are blocked.

build_plan.name: Extraction and ingestion
actions: Add extracted_actions, extracted_ideas, snippets, contradiction_registry and merge_candidates
build_plan.done_when: Browser/LLM content can be stored, parsed, linked and traced to source.

build_plan.name: Research and commercial layers
actions: Add datasets, studies, papers, posters, simulations, claims
build_plan.done_when: Research claims and commercial offers are parent-linked and evidence-bound.

build_plan.name: QA and telemetry
build_plan.done_when: Runtime status, drift and evidence are visible as queryable views.

build_plan.name: Dev handoff and prod promotion
actions: Open/update dev issue or PR payload
build_plan.done_when: Dev has complete code bundle and prod promotion gate criteria.

bridge_instructions.preferred_path: Bridge worker reads this PEN inbox payload, builds bundle in dev, runs validations, writes receipt to receipts/runtime/portfolio-operating-graph-canonical-build-v1.json, then opens/updates dev PR for promotion gating.
bridge_instructions.fallback_path: If bridge is unavailable, create dev issue with full payload and mark evidence PARTIAL until receipt file exists.
bridge_instructions.write_policy: No destructive operations. All schema changes must be additive/idempotent.
